description:
Elif Tofauti-Adu is slight and easy to overlook, which is exactly the point. At 33, he has the kind of face that changes depending on the light â€” trustworthy in daylight, dangerous after dark. He arrived in GLMZ six years ago with nothing but chrome and debts, and has been working off both ever since. He works as a wheelman out of the Gray Zone, taking contracts that match his skills and his risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

Everyone who's worked with Elif Tofauti-Adu agrees on two things: he is worth the fee, and he is terrible company at dinner.

stress_responses.high: Goes quiet. The silence is not calm â€” it's the sound of every contingency being evaluated simultaneously.
stress_responses.critical: Berserker clarity. Everything becomes simple: survive. Deal with the rest later. The simplicity is almost peaceful.

physical_description.heritage: Central Asian dominant (58.1%) with significant Pacific Islander (27.6%) and South Asian (14.3%) heritage. The genetic blend creates striking phenotypic complexity: warm golden-bronze undertones from Central Asian steppe ancestry layered with sun-kissed warmth from Pacific Islander heritage, refined by South Asian facial geometry. The combination produces a warm, weathered appearance with pronounced cheekbones and strong jawlineâ€”a face shaped by multiple continental bloodlines that reads as both austere and vital.
physical_description.build: Lean and efficient â€” minimal excess mass, all functional muscle. Wiry frame built for sustained output rather than explosive power, with the posture of someone who has trained their body as a tool.
physical_description.hair_color: Dark brown, naturalized with gray threading at temples
physical_description.hair_style: Short, practical cut kept at precisely 2cm length â€” no maintenance vanity, pure function
physical_description.eye_color: Deep brown with faint chrome-rim scarring around the orbital sockets â€” sign of repeated surgical interface
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm bronze with golden undertones from Central Asian and Pacific Islander heritage, carrying depth and refinement from South Asian ancestry. Base tone is medium-rich and luminous, with honey-amber qualities that catch light distinctly. Carries pallor from irregular sleep cycles and minimal sun exposure, creating a slightly matte quality that contrasts with underlying warmth.
physical_description.complexion: Strong, high cheekbones with angular Central Asian placement, lean jaw with pronounced strength reflecting South Asian ancestry. Facial structure shows the refined geometry of steppe heritage combined with Pacific Islander bone depth and warmth. Skin shows fine stress lines around eyes and mouth â€” accumulated tension rather than age. Thin scar tissue along left temple from surgical access points. Grooming is military-precise: clean-shaven daily, nails trimmed to function, no ornamentation.

Fine webbed scarring across inner right wrist â€” old cut, deliberately kept rather than healed clean, marks a decision point

physical_description.visible_augmentations: Cranial implant is the statement piece â€” fine chrome circuitry visible at left temple in geometric patterns, deliberately left unhidden. The pattern catches light in a way that reads as either medical necessity or a warning. Subcutaneous wiring traces visible under translucent patches of skin on neck and upper chest when he moves, suggesting extensive neural integration beneath.
physical_description.posture_movement: Economical and alert. Sits with spine straight, eyes tracking entrances and exits reflexively. Moves like someone counting milliseconds â€” no wasted motion, each gesture purposeful. Hands are steady and quick. When still, he has an uncanny calm that makes people uncomfortable; when moving, he's already three steps ahead of the room.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 utilitarian. Matte-black reinforced jacket with integrated comms pockets, custom-fitted for concealed hardware.
